character.description: right-facing sleek silver piercing dolphin with a pointed beak and sharp crescent tail

swim.action: right-facing two-frame swimming loop at strict identity, scale and center lock: preserve the long pointed beak, sleek narrow body, low swept dorsal fin, eye, bright silver flank and sharp crescent forked tail; frame 1 bends the attached tail one logical pixel upward and lowers the visible pectoral fin, frame 2 bends the same tail one logical pixel downward and raises the pectoral fin; keep head and torso completely stable with no translation, rotation or bobbing; no beam, projectile, lightning, glow, water, shadow, text, UI, detached fin or loose pixel

style: native 18x10 hard-edged pixel art with large countable clusters, one-pixel deep navy outline and a limited silver-white-cool-blue-gray palette; fast precise arcade companion
